name: Gloomtouched
body:
This disease destroys a creature’s self-worth, making them pliable subjects. Those that succumb to the disease become one of the wretched.

Type disease (contact); Save Will DC 14

Onset 1 day; Frequency 1 day

Effect 1d6 Cha damage. A creature that reaches 0 Cha becomes wretched; Cure 3 consecutive saves
